title: See which stories the code changes reach
statement: As a product manager, I can see which stories and acceptance criteria a release's code changes reach, so I find out what is really in play and not only what we meant to ship.
overview: This uses the walk `review test-plan` already does, from changed code through documentation and test evidence to stories, over a release's range and not a review's. It holds no list that can fall behind Git. A hand link remains how to say a release delivers a story, or affects one the code does not reach.

acceptance_criteria.statement: For a release with a range, `release stories` lists each story reached by a changed line and the criteria of those stories.
Each story names the changed file and the record that connects it.
The release's page separates stories found from the code from stories only linked by hand, and marks those that are both.
Stories found from the code are computed when asked and are not written to the release.
